## How to use a prompt

1. Open a prompt file and copy the block under **Prompt**.
2. Paste it into Fable 5.5 (or any agent running it) and ask for the result as a single HTML file.
3. Record the page if you want a video.

Some creators shared only part of their prompt, or only described the result in their post; those files say so.

## Credits

Every video and prompt belongs to its creator, linked from each entry. If you are a creator and want an entry changed or removed, open an issue — handled within 72 hours, no questions asked. See [CREDITS.md](CREDITS.md).
